item.title: Oil CEO urges Newsom to do the 'math' as California governor vows to stop offshore drilling
item.summary: Trump invokes Defense Production Act to restart California offshore drilling operations as Gov. Newsom alleges defiance of court orders amid Iran conflict.

item.title: New video shows terror suspect tackled after allegedly throwing bomb at NYC protest outside mayor's residence
item.summary: Video shows accused terror suspect tackled after allegedly throwing homemade bomb at NYC protest outside Gracie Mansion. NYPD calls it ISIS-inspired.

item.title: NATO heavyweights balk at Hormuz mission as Trump warns alliance at risk
item.summary: UK, France and Germany decline combat roles in protecting key oil choke point, drawing warnings from Trump and GOP allies about NATO’s reliability.

item.title: Jerry O'Connell says he's quitting podcasts after viral Bill Maher appearance
item.summary: Actor Jerry O'Connell announced he was quitting podcasts after facing family backlash and social media criticism over remarks he made on Bill Maher's show.

item.title: GOP candidate cites ‘failure’ of Newsom, Dems as new poll shows Republicans leading crowded California field
item.summary: Steve Hilton, a Republican running for governor, said that the “absolute failure" by California Gov. Gavin Newsom and Democrats means that the GOP has a real shot at victory this year.

item.title: University of Alabama student James Gracey disappears in Barcelona after visiting friends studying abroad
item.summary: University of Alabama student Jimmy Gracey, 20, missing in Barcelona after visiting nightclub during spring break trip. Last seen 3 a.m. March 17.

item.title: Lori Loughlin's ageless appearance has fans doing a double take at charity event
item.summary: Lori Loughlin's ageless appearance at Beverly Hills gala leaves "Full House" fans stunned, with social media users saying they barely recognize the star.

item.title: Oddsmaker goes beyond brackets, discusses popular betting trends and upset wagers for March Madness
item.summary: Johnny Avello said March Madness betting trends show increased action on lower seeds, as narrowing spreads made underdogs more appealing to bettors.

item.title: Kai Trump resumes training for University of Miami golf season following wrist surgery: 'We're so back'
item.summary: After weeks of recovery from wrist surgery, 18-year-old golfer Kai Trump shared her return to training ahead of her University of Miami freshman season.

item.title: Blue-state Democrat on fast track to Senate defies Schumer
item.summary: Illinois Lt. Gov. Juliana Stratton wins Democratic Senate primary race but vows not to support Chuck Schumer as majority leader in Washington.
